headline: Fox Mandal & Associates advises Kotak Mahindra Investments on extending ₹300 crore+ to Adarsh Developers
sum: Kotak Mahindra Investments Limited is set to extend project funding of approximately ₹300 crores+ to Adarsh Developers for its residential project 'District 25 – Phase I'. Fox Mandal & Associates advised Kotak Mahindra Investments on this…
detail: Kotak Mahindra Investments Limited is set to extend project funding of approximately ₹300 crores+ to Adarsh Developers for its residential project 'District 25 – Phase I'. Fox Mandal & Associates advised Kotak Mahindra Investments on this transaction. The Firm's role involved comprehensive legal due diligence, title verification, review of project-related approvals and documentation, and advisory support. The transaction was led by ST Prashantha Kumar (Senior Partner), under the supervision of Mali Pavan Gowda (Group Head, Real Estate) along with Adesh S (Senior Associate), Anjana Uday (Senior Associate), Associates Nitesh Rao and Yashaswini Shettigar, Assessment Trainee Lavanya.
